elements.title: Top-to-Ground Aggregation (T2GA)

figure.caption: Column-wise attention mechanism aggregating features from elevated structures like streetlights.

bullets: Transformer attention aligns elevated features with their ground-level base
Column-wise aggregation fuses reliable off-ground cues into the feature map
Enhances landmark detection for more precise vehicle pose estimation

builds.audio_segment: T2GA uses transformer attention to aggregate features from elevated structures onto their ground-level base.
This transformer attention mechanism specifically aligns elevated features with their corresponding ground-level base.
By processing pixels column-wise, it fuses reliable off-ground cues into the feature map.
This highlights vertical landmarks, providing the precise geometric cues needed for accurate localization and vehicle pose estimation.
